mech.title: SpiritVale Game Mechanics
mech.sub: Every combat formula, stat, element, weapon, class, and status in SpiritVale, pulled straight from the game’s own code.
mech.prov.text: Values are read directly from the game’s compiled code (GameAssembly.dll).
mech.note.essence: Essences re-roll an equip’s substats. Every item drops with a finite Potential budget; each essence spends some Potential plus coins to change its substats, and once Potential runs out the item can’t be re-rolled again.
mech.e.costNote: Coin cost = the average Potential a roll spends × {n} coins per point of Potential.
mech.e.scaleNote: Substat values scale from {floor}% of the stat’s range (a fresh roll) up to 100% (a perfect roll). Flow chases 100%; the Chaos slot is locked at the floor.
mech.e.dropNote: Essences drop from monsters (shown as the Essence ×N tag on a monster’s page). A random drop is weighted:
mech.e.chaosNote: Chaos is a gamble: it spends all remaining Potential on one of four equally-likely rolls.
mech.note.formulas: How each stat is calculated from your attributes and gear.
mech.note.weapons: Base Attack Delay (BAD) drives attack speed — higher is slower. Below are the dual-wield, two-hand, and ranged weapon groups, and each weapon type’s BAD.
mech.note.archetypes: Each class’s HP multiplier (how much Max HP scales as you level), starting attributes, and max job level. Advanced classes inherit their base class’s HP multiplier and start their attributes at 1.
mech.note.elements: How much damage each attacking element (row) deals against each defending element (column). Blank means normal damage (×1.0).
mech.note.xp: EXP needed for each level and the running total, up to level 150.
mech.note.stats: Every stat in the game’s StatType list, with its ID, name, and whether it’s a percentage stat.
mech.note.effects: Every buff, debuff, and damage-over-time status in the game, with its element and stacking behavior.
mech.w.wield: Off-hand slot: a Shield or Grimoire, or a second Dual-wield-capable weapon (above). Dual wielding requires the Dual Wield Mastery skill (Gun Mastery for Pistols). Two-handed weapons occupy both hands and disable the off-hand; every other one-handed weapon is main-hand only.
